references.text: The basis for the redemption of the firstborn is established here, where every firstborn who opens the womb shall be redeemed
Defines the sanctuary shekel as twenty gerahs, the same weight standard used in Numbers 18:16
The valuation of children from one month to five years in silver, related to the redemption price for firstborns
The same redemption price of five shekels according to the sanctuary shekel for those firstborns who exceed the number of Levites
Practical application of the redemption price of five shekels for the 273 firstborn Israelites
Confirms that the shekel is twenty gerahs, the same weight standard mentioned in Numbers 18:16
Jesus is presented to the Lord in the temple in accordance with the law concerning the firstborn, which includes the tradition of redemption
